basic_profile.bio: I'm a 33-year-old music enthusiast from Chicago, Illinois, who recently got into Reddit. My main passion is playing the guitar, and I'm a huge fan of Billy Strings. I spend my free time exploring new musical genres and participating in online forums about music and gaming. Currently unemployed due to the pandemic, I'm actively seeking new opportunities while navigating the unemployment system. My typical online hours are late evenings, especially after dinner. I'm single and enjoy discussing tech gadgets, particularly smartphones.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in music, having played guitar for over 10 years. Most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching, online courses, and jam sessions with friends. Recently, I've been expanding my tech knowledge through YouTube tutorials and forums, especially about smartphones.
